about: Decks made from the data (data.places@PrompTugal.dinis): each slide is a query over the tables of /query/, run by the build. A place deck is made for every place from place_deck ({place}, {name}); the named decks are written for a meeting. Slide kinds: title, stat (one row, each column a figure), text ({column} from the first row), list (an item template per row), table, bars (label and value).

place_deck.kicker: PrompTugal.news by place, from the data
place_deck.title: {name}: AI in context
place_deck.text: Every figure on these slides is a query over the site's own data, run at build v{version} on {today}. Each slide links to its query: run it, change it, check it.

place_deck.title: {name} in numbers
place_deck.sql: SELECT news AS local_AI_stories, map AS on_the_AI_map, events, sources AS sources_read, (SELECT count(*) FROM captures c WHERE c.ok = 1 AND (','||c.places||',') LIKE '%,{place},%') AS pages_captured FROM places WHERE id = '{place}'

place_deck.title: The centre of gravity
place_deck.sql: SELECT gravity FROM places WHERE id = '{place}'

place_deck.title: The AI map
place_deck.sql: SELECT name, kind, steps, ai_path FROM map WHERE place = '{place}' ORDER BY steps, name

place_deck.title: The local AI stories
place_deck.sql: SELECT date, title, publisher FROM news WHERE place = '{place}' ORDER BY date DESC

place_deck.title: Who {name} shares with the rest of the region
place_deck.sql: SELECT n.label AS label, group_concat(DISTINCT replace(e2.dst, 'place:', '')) AS also_in FROM edges e1 JOIN nodes n ON n.id = e1.src JOIN edges e2 ON e2.src = e1.src AND e2.verb = 'on_ai_map_of' AND e2.dst != 'place:{place}' WHERE e1.verb = 'on_ai_map_of' AND e1.dst = 'place:{place}' GROUP BY n.id ORDER BY n.label
place_deck.empty: No organisation on {name}'s map is on another place's map yet.

place_deck.title: Two steps out: named in the same stories
place_deck.sql: SELECT label, type, path FROM neighbours('place:{place}', 2, 'reported_in,mentions') WHERE depth = 2 AND type IN ('company', 'organisation', 'place') ORDER BY type, label
place_deck.empty: No story of {name} names another organisation yet.

place_deck.title: Provenance
place_deck.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT url) AS pages_cited, count(DISTINCT host) AS sites, min(read_on) AS first_read, max(read_on) AS last_read FROM (SELECT url, host, read_on FROM news WHERE place = '{place}' UNION ALL SELECT source_url, host, read_on FROM map WHERE place = '{place}')
place_deck.text: Every item names its source and the day it was read; the pages are captured (a screenshot and the text, each with its SHA-256) in the sgit vault promptugal-captures.

place_deck.title: What we have not found yet
place_deck.sql: SELECT text FROM gaps WHERE place = '{place}' ORDER BY n

place_deck.title: promptugal.news/query/{place}/
place_deck.text: The tables, the graph and every query behind these slides, in the browser; the JSON at api/v1/data/places/{place}.json.

decks.title: Algarve Evolution, connected
decks.summary: Algarve Evolution in PrompTugal.news's data: the towns that map it, the stories and events that name it, who it is connected to, and the region around it.
decks.for: Dinis's meeting with Algarve Evolution, 16 November 2026

slides.title: Algarve Evolution, connected
slides.text: What nineteen place agents found on their own, joined into one graph: every figure is a query over the site's data, run at build v{version} on {today}, and each slide links to its query.

slides.title: In the data
slides.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT dst) FROM edges WHERE src = 'organisation:algarve-evolution' AND verb = 'on_ai_map_of') AS towns_that_map_it, (SELECT count(*) FROM edges e JOIN nodes n ON n.id = e.src WHERE e.dst = 'organisation:algarve-evolution' AND e.verb = 'mentions' AND n.type = 'news') AS stories_that_name_it, (SELECT count(*) FROM neighbours('organisation:algarve-evolution', 1) WHERE type = 'event') AS events, (SELECT count(*) FROM neighbours('organisation:algarve-evolution', 2, 'mentions') WHERE depth = 2 AND type IN ('company', 'organisation')) AS organisations_two_steps_away

slides.title: The stories that name it
slides.sql: SELECT DISTINCT n.date, n.title, n.publisher FROM edges e JOIN news n ON n.node = e.src WHERE e.dst = 'organisation:algarve-evolution' AND e.verb = 'mentions' ORDER BY n.date DESC

slides.title: The events
slides.sql: SELECT DISTINCT label FROM neighbours('organisation:algarve-evolution', 1) WHERE type = 'event' ORDER BY label

slides.title: Two steps away: named in the same stories
slides.sql: SELECT label, type, path FROM neighbours('organisation:algarve-evolution', 2, 'mentions') WHERE depth = 2 AND type IN ('company', 'organisation') ORDER BY label

slides.title: The AI map of the Algarve, by place
slides.sql: SELECT name AS label, map AS value FROM places WHERE kind = 'municipality' ORDER BY map DESC, name

slides.title: Found by several place agents on their own
slides.sql: SELECT n.label AS label, count(DISTINCT e.dst) AS towns, group_concat(DISTINCT replace(e.dst, 'place:', '')) AS places FROM edges e JOIN nodes n ON n.id = e.src WHERE e.verb = 'on_ai_map_of' GROUP BY n.id HAVING towns > 1 ORDER BY towns DESC, label

slides.title: What the detectives connected
slides.sql: SELECT a.label AS a, c.verb AS verb, b.label AS b, c.verified AS verified FROM connections c JOIN nodes a ON a.id = c.src JOIN nodes b ON b.id = c.dst ORDER BY c.verified, a.label

slides.title: Provenance
slides.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM captures WHERE ok = 1) AS pages_captured, (SELECT count(DISTINCT host) FROM captures WHERE ok = 1) AS sites, (SELECT count(*) FROM news) AS stories, (SELECT count(*) FROM map) AS map_entries
slides.text: Every story and map entry carries its source and the day it was read; the source pages of Loulé and Faro are captured, a screenshot and the text with their SHA-256, in an sgit vault.

slides.title: promptugal.news/query/
slides.text: Nineteen places, the graph, SQL and graph traversals in the browser, and the JSON behind every slide.
